resources.string: You and a friend, on this phone

The board has 9 cells. Two players take turns putting their mark, X or O, in an empty cell.

X always moves first. Choose X to start, or O to let the other player start.

Three of your marks in a row wins: across, down or diagonally.

When all 9 cells are full and nobody has three in a row, the game is a draw.

With Jarvis: Jarvis plays the other mark. It reads the board and the same rules, and takes about 15 to 30 seconds a move. It may talk while it plays. Pause sends Jarvis away; Resume brings it back to the same board.

Rematch plays the same opponent again with the marks swapped, so each side starts in turn. The score counts until you pick a new game.
